name: BACH_0247
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Normal (99%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Single-class conformal set, MUSK agrees, and 5/5 similar cases are Normal [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Normal 99%, Benign 1% | One clear leader |
| Conformal set | {Normal} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.99 / 56th percentile | Typical input |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Agrees |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Normal | Neighbors agree |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules** (regions 0, 10, 11) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score; largest push away from invasive (−0.62) [F2] · Unreliable
- **Benign stroma or fat** (region 9) · ↓ invasive · Small push away from invasive (−0.07) · Validated
- **Tumor-infiltrating stroma** (region 8) · ↑ invasive · Small push toward invasive (+0.07) · Validated
- **Nuclear size** (regions 3, 7, 8) · context · Mean 40 µm²; 0th reference percentile · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions lowers the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to classifier.
- **Concepts**: Effect 0.002 (CI −0.005 to 0.007) includes 0, so not shown faithful; normal lobules and mitoses are Unreliable (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Neoplastic nuclei HoVer-Net found (29% in regions 3, 7, 8) are real tumor cells.
- Calibration is off: it was tested on only 132 images (ECE 5%, CI 3–18%).

## Check on the slide
1. **Region 7**: 19 nuclei labeled neoplastic; confirm whether they are truly atypical.
2. **Region 8**: Strongest tumor-infiltrating stroma score; look for invasive nests.
3. **Regions 0, 10, 11**: Normal-lobule score failed spot check; confirm lobular architecture yourself.
